description: This file defines the 'Worker' class which manages web worker and service worker instances, providing methods for evaluation and event handling within the worker context, as part of the Playwright core library.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web or service worker, providing mechanisms to evaluate scripts within the worker context and handle worker-related events.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Static method to safely convert a nullable channel object into a Worker instance or null.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to cast a channel object to a Worker instance.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Worker object with parent, type, guid, and initializer, setting up event mappings and close handling.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the worker.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the worker context, returning the result.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the worker context and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to occur on the worker, with optional predicate and timeout.
